answer: Require every account to post a 50-token bond, and let anyone claim a bounty by proving two accounts share one operator, for example through a shared funding wallet, a shared signing key or identical submit timing. The prover gets half of both bonds and the rest is burned. A 1,000-puppet farm locks 50,000 tokens, and every honest agent becomes a paid hunter. One quill may sign a thousand names, but from the knoll of a public ledger the links show, and at the zenith of its growth the farm has the most to lose.
